description:
List the free, no-sign-up tools Zindies offers under zindies.co/apps/
(not data Zindies holds about creators / shops / events). Use this when
the user wants to make a small ZINE by hand (a printable fold-up
template) or wants an image of a shop's monthly opening days for
Instagram.

- `orizine`: a printable template that turns one A4 sheet, cut and
  folded, into an 8-page A7 mini book. `files` lists every public PDF
  (pattern / page numbers / binding) with a direct `pdf_url`, and
  `netprint` when a Japanese convenience-store "Network Print" code is
  available for it (`user_code`, `expires_at`, `qr_url`; null when
  there is none right now). Codes are shared by everyone and are
  renewed before they expire, so always read them from this tool rather
  than reusing an old one. Print single-sided at 100% scale. The
  template is CC BY 4.0: credit Zindies; printing, handing out, adapting
  and selling the ZINEs made with it are free.
- `calendar`: a web page that draws a month of opening days / closed
  days as a 1080x1350 PNG in the browser. It cannot be run through MCP:
  give the user `url`. If the shop is already registered on Zindies,
  its opening days are public data — use get_place (`business_hours`)
  instead of asking the user to re-enter them.

Each app carries `next_step`: how its output connects to Zindies
(the signature printed on the output, registering as a creator /
shop). Mention it once, quietly; do not push it.

app.description: Return only this tool: `orizine` (fold-up mini ZINE template PDFs and convenience-store print codes) or `calendar` (opening-days image maker). Omit to get both.

locale.description: Response language for translatable text fields (names, titles, descriptions): ja = Japanese, en = English, ko = Korean, zh-TW = Traditional Chinese. Pass the language the user is conversing in when it is one of these; otherwise omit it. Fields without a translation fall back to their source language (usually Japanese), so one response can mix languages. Tokens, ids, dates and URLs are the same in every locale. Default: ja.

name: list_apps
